purpose: Teach: 歳月/安打/口実/地検/回生/町並み/孔/陵

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、長い歳月の慢性疾患を医療チームでフォローします
lines.en: Ren — we follow chronic conditions over the long term with our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, clinical but not cold. Steady opener. Measured pace. The voice of someone who has delivered this explanation many times and means it each time.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の野球選手の安打スランプを医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Yes — we support patients through all kinds of challenges with our team's care.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Slightly slower than the previous line. Reassuring without being patronizing. The tone that says: this is something we do well.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の通院口実を医療チームで丁寧に聞きます
lines.en: Ren — we listen carefully to what brings patients in, with our whole team behind that listening.
lines.style: Thoughtful, unhurried. Opens with intention. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' — this is what distinguishes her approach. Warm but clinical clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地検からの照会に、貴院、丁寧に応じられますね、先生
lines.en: You respond thoughtfully to inquiries from the prosecutor's office, don't you, Doctor.
lines.style: Observant, slightly formal in register. Not a question despite the period — a statement of respect. Quiet certainty underneath. The voice of someone noticing something true about her.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、留年医学生の回生サポートを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes — we support medical students who need to repeat their studies, as a team effort.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact compassion. No hesitation. The answer of someone who has seen this before and treats it as ordinary work. Steady professional tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 町並み保存地区の地域医療を、貴院、担当されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital takes on the healthcare needs of the historic preservation district, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful observation, almost gentle in its directness. A statement framed as a question. Small pause before 'Doctor' — the weight of appreciation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、皮膚の孔詰まりの治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we handle dermatological treatment as part of our team's scope.
lines.style: Clinical, direct. No unnecessary softening. The voice of competent professional work. Steady rhythm, brief.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、皇族陵墓警備時の救護を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we provide medical support during events at imperial burial sites, with our team.
lines.style: Formal, composed. Slight weight on the gravity of the role without emphasizing it. Close, warm but professional — the doctor who understands what's being asked.
